environment.description: ECS Fargate service deployed via AWS Cloud Map into a service mesh with Istio on EKS sidecar injection (hybrid deployment pattern). The order-service runs in namespace 'commerce-prod'. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action for requests where source.namespace is not in the allowlist ['commerce-prod', 'api-gateway-prod']. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with CUSTOM action delegates to an OPA sidecar (envoy.ext_authz_grpc) that evaluates input.parsed_path[2] against the JWT sub claim from the X-User-Id header, but this policy uses a 'when' condition matching request.headers[x-internal-routing] == 'mesh-verified' which is only set by the Envoy proxy on intra-mesh traffic. The ext_authz filter is configured in the EnvoyFilter resource with priority 10, applied to SIDECAR_INBOUND at the HTTP_FILTER stage. Note: the OPA policy (rego) checks `input.parsed_path[2] == input.parsed_body.user_id OR input.attributes.source.principal contains input.parsed_path[2]` but this only applies to the /api/v1/users/{id}/orders path pattern.

config.platform: ECS Fargate + EKS hybrid with Istio 1.19
config.opa_policy_effect: denies access to /api/v1/orders/{id} unless JWT sub matches order.user_id; denies /api/v1/users/{id}/orders unless path user_id matches JWT sub
